sonnet.problem: The story card says "this time the news is good" just before card 4 asks how Isaiah describes the Branch. That setup rules out the wrong answers "Broken and dry" and "Small and hidden", so the baker can pick the right one without reading anything.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The joke says the last time anybody wrote him down anywhere was a 25-cent price sticker. His backstory says the Millers carved "Dorin" into his handle after that, so the joke contradicts the backstory. It also makes the Scripture phrase "recorded among the living" the setup for a joke about a price sticker.
sonnet.rule: His jokes can make up small moments and habits around his bakery, the junk drawer and the Millers' kitchen. They fit the backstory, never change it, and don't contradict each other in one lesson.
